summary: Iteration 10 tested the 3 new features end-to-end. BACKEND (13/13 pytest pass, /app/backend/tests/test_delivery_area_brands.py): GET /api/delivery/area returns centerZip 32832 / Orlando / radius 20 / zipCount 38 with exactly the expected city grouping (Orlando 27, Kissimmee 4, Saint Cloud 3, Winter Park 2, Christmas 1, Oviedo 1), every zip has distanceMiles<=20, cities sorted desc by count; second call identical + fast (cached); PUT /api/admin/settings deliveryRadiusMiles=10 shrinks the area (all distances <=10) and restore to 20 brings zipCount back to 38. Brand logos: GET /api/brands = {brands:[]}, unauthenticated PUT -> 403, admin PUT muha -> 200 {slug,name,image} and appears in public GET (no _id), re-PUT updates in place (no duplicate), blank slug ('%20%20') -> 400, DELETE -> {ok:true} and list empty; POST /api/admin/upload with a tiny PNG returns /api/files/... which serves 200 image/png and can be set as a brand logo. Sitemap: /sitemap.xml and /api/sitemap.xml both 200 xml with exactly 115 incl. https://puff2door.com/delivery-area; robots.txt unchanged. FRONTEND: /delivery-area correct title/single h1/canonical, JSON-LD includes Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Service (all valid JSON), ZIP checker green for 32801 (15.8 mi) and red for 33101, 6 city cards with zips+distances, 4 FAQ cards, 'Shop All Products' -> /shop. Navigation: nav-delivery-area (1920px), mobile-delivery-area (390x844), footer 'Orlando Delivery Area', home delivery-banner-link 'See delivery area' and 'Orlando neighborhoods and ZIP codes we deliver to' all present and navigating. Admin /admin/brands: sidebar 'Brand Logos', 35 brand rows, header '6 of 35 currently have a logo', brand-search filters (muha -> 1 row), URL mode save -> 'Logo saved' toast + row 'custom logo' + stat 7/35 + /brands muha renders ; reset+save -> 'Custom logo removed' and muha is text again; file-upload path on 'cake' uploads, previews (/api/files/...png) and saves, then removed -> back to 6/35. GA4: view_item, add_to_cart, add_payment_info (zelle), purchase (exactly one, transaction_id P2D-17514710, value 57.6, tax 2.6, shipping 15, items) all correct; purchase guard verified (still 1 after 8s of polling, 0 on reload, sessionStorage key p2d_ga_purchase_ set). Regression: /brands 35 tiles, Brands dropdown 35, Shop dropdown 7, /api/products 67, home title unchanged, checkout blocks ZIP 33101 (payment-blocked + checkout-submit-blocked). FOUND AND FIXED ONE CRITICAL BUG (missing import) - details below. State restored: brands collection empty, delivery radius 20.

integration_issues.flow: Add to Cart / Remove from cart (ALL pages)
integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL (FIXED BY TESTER): /app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.js used `ecommerce.addToCart` / `ecommerce.removeFromCart` without importing it -> 'ReferenceError: ecommerce is not defined' thrown from addItem, so clicking Add to Cart did nothing at all (cart stayed empty, CRA error overlay shown). The entire purchase funnel was broken. Fixed by adding `import { ecommerce } from "../seo/Analytics";`. Please keep this import.

begin_checkout fires TWICE on /checkout mount (both value 57.6). Cause: mount useEffect([]) double-invoked by React.StrictMode in dev; will be once in a production build, but the event has no idempotency guard. Recommend a useRef/sessionStorage guard like the purchase guard.

remove_from_cart fires TWICE per removal. Cause is a real code smell, not just StrictMode: ecommerce.removeFromCart() is called INSIDE the setItems(prev => ...) updater in CartContext.removeItem, so the impure updater's double-invocation duplicates the analytics hit. Move the tracking call outside the state updater.

2 page_view events on initial page load (same page_path) from the Analytics [pathname,search] effect being double-invoked on StrictMode mount. Dev-only, but a mounted-once ref guard would make it deterministic.

action_items: KEEP the ecommerce import added to /app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.js (Add to Cart was completely broken without it) — and add a smoke test for add-to-cart.
Move ecommerce.removeFromCart() out of the setItems updater in CartContext.removeItem (currently double-fires).
Add a once-guard for begin_checkout (and optionally page_view) so StrictMode/remount cannot duplicate the events.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext.js referenced `ecommerce` with no import — a lint/CI check (eslint no-undef on the frontend) would have caught this before shipping; the add-to-cart path had no test coverage.
Side effects (analytics) inside React state updater functions are impure and duplicate under StrictMode/concurrent rendering.
GET /api/delivery/area cache is a single-entry module dict (_area_cache.clear() then set) — fine for one settings value but resets on every radius change; acceptable, no action needed.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all delivery-area/nav/admin-brands/purchase checks pass; 3 duplicate-GA-event issues, 1 critical add-to-cart bug found & fixed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Age gate: click [data-testid=age-gate-yes] then wait ~2.5s. Checkout State select uses FULL state names ('Florida', not 'FL'). Zelle order flow: fill checkout-firstName/lastName/email/phone/address/city/state/zip(32801) -> click [data-testid=pay-method-zelle] -> [data-testid=checkout-submit] -> lands on /order/<uuid>. GA events read via window.dataLayer entries as arguments objects: (window.dataLayer||[]).map(a=>Array.from(a)).filter(a=>a[0]==='event'). Admin brand rows: [data-testid^=brand-row-] also matches brand-row-name-<slug>, so filter with :not([data-testid*=-name-]) (35 rows). Brand search input is [data-testid=brand-search] (the header product search also matches placeholder*=Search). After the ecommerce-import fix, verify duplicate begin_checkout/remove_from_cart once the main agent adds guards.
rca_of_the_issue: Critical: /app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.js was refactored to emit GA4 add_to_cart/remove_from_cart but the `ecommerce` symbol was never imported, so addItem threw ReferenceError on the first click — Add to Cart silently failed everywhere (localStorage p2d_cart stayed '[]', CRA overlay displayed 'ecommerce is not defined at addItem'). Fix: added the import from ../seo/Analytics; re-verified add_to_cart, begin_checkout, add_payment_info and a real purchase now fire and an order completes. Secondary: duplicate begin_checkout/page_view come from StrictMode double-invoked mount effects (dev-only), while duplicate remove_from_cart comes from calling the analytics helper inside the setItems updater (impure updater) and should be fixed in code.
